530501.name: Minigun Beam
530501.description: Fires the machine guns mounted on both sides of her body, dealing damage to a single Nikke. The machine guns can be destroyed.

530502.name: Burning Shot
530502.description: Fires leg-mounted missiles, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

530503.name: Spike Missile
530503.description: Fires shoulder-mounted missiles, dealing damage to a single Nikke. The missiles can be intercepted.

530504.name: Mini Meteor
530504.description: Lobs a massive fireball, dealing damage to a single Nikke. The fireball can be intercepted.

530505.name: Megiddo Flame
530505.description:
Hits all Nikkes with dragon breath, dealing damage.
Deals significant sustained damage if the attack hits.

530506.name: Feather Missile
530506.description: Spreads her wings and fires missiles, dealing damage to a single Nikke. The missiles can be intercepted.

530507.name: Thunder Spear
530507.description: Emits a linear arc of electricity from her right head, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

530509.name: Burning Scourge
530509.description:
Spews flames while airbone, dealing damage to all Nikkes.
Deals significant sustained damage if the attack hits.
